commands.review_summary:
The branch changes the agent-core compaction estimator so positive provider `totalTokens` is preferred and zero/missing totals fall back to `input + output`, with regression tests for the reported cached-usage overcount.

PR surface: Source +5, Tests +91. Total +96 across 2 files.

target.title: fix(compaction): avoid cached usage overcount
target.body:
﻿Closes #99843

AI-assisted: Codex.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where long cached agent turns could auto-compact far below the configured reserve threshold when the context estimator received a turn-aggregated usage object with `totalTokens` missing or zero. In that state, repeated `cacheRead` buckets from multiple provider calls were summed as if they were one context-window snapshot, so sessions could compact early and report a misleadingly huge token count.

## Why This Change Was Made

The estimator now treats positive provider `totalTokens` as the trusted context snapshot and stops using cache read/write buckets as a fallback context estimate. That preserves current behavior for normal provider snapshots while preventing aggregated cache accounting from driving compaction thresholds; billing and usage accumulation remain unchanged.

## User Impact

Users running long cached tool-loop sessions should no longer see safeguard compaction fire early just because cached prompt tokens were counted repeatedly across calls. The compaction banner and threshold decision stay tied to actual context snapshots when providers report them.

## Evidence

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.test.ts --reporter=verbose` -> 1 file passed, 4 tests passed.
- `node --import tsx -e "const m = await import('./packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.ts'); const usage = { input: 12, output: 15104, cacheRead: 819661, cacheWrite: 93130, totalTokens: 0, cost: { input: 0, output: 0, cacheRead: 0, cacheWrite: 0, total: 0 } }; const got = m.calculateContextTokens(usage); console.log(got); if (got !== 15116) process.exit(1);"` -> `15116`.
- `node --import tsx -e "const m = await import('./packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.ts'); const usage = { input: 12, output: 15104, cacheRead: 819661, cacheWrite: 93130, totalTokens: 163978, cost: { input: 0, output: 0, cacheRead: 0, cacheWrite: 0, total: 0 } }; const got = m.calculateContextTokens(usage); console.log(got); if (got !== 163978) process.exit(1);"` -> `163978`.
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.ts packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.test.ts`.
- `git diff --check -- packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.ts packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.test.ts`.
- `PYTHONUTF8=1 python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main` -> clean, no accepted/actionable findings, overall `patch is correct`.

Crabbox/Testbox proof was attempted but blocked in this Windows environment: the local Crabbox shim failed sanity checks, `../crabbox/bin/crabbox` was absent, and `blacksmith` was not installed. The targeted Vitest and pure-function probes above were run against the same committed PR head `6cc347b83c8969186432ef6b5d73ca30eed37da8`.
